{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.04

|gr1= Containers

|descr= Returns array of backpacks stored in given crate or vehicle. Used for accessing backpack content of a backpack on ground.

|s1= [[everyBackpack]] box

|p1= box: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Object]]s

|x1= <sqf>everyBackpack cursorTarget;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_vehicleBackpacks = everyBackpack vehicle player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[firstBackpack]] [[unitBackpack]] [[backpack]] [[backpackCargo]] [[getBackpackCargo]] [[backpackItems]] [[addBackpack]] [[addBackpackCargo]] [[addBackpackCargoGlobal]] [[removeBackpack]] [[clearBackpackCargo]] [[clearBackpackCargoGlobal]] [[clearAllItemsFromBackpack]] [[loadBackpack]] [[backpackSpaceFor]] [[canAddItemToBackpack]] [[addItemToBackpack]] [[removeItemFromBackpack]] [[backpackContainer]] [[everyContainer]] [[backpacks]]
}}

{{Note
|user= ffur2007slx2_5
|timestamp= 20140429170900
|text= ({{arma3}} ver 1.16), here's a quick reference to backpack command family.
{{{!}} class="wikitable sortable"

! Command
! Operand type
! Return
! Example

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[firstBackpack]]
{{!}} [[Object]] (WeaponHolder, AmmoCrate, VehicleCrate)
{{!}} [[Object]] (e.g 2bba9d00# 163957: backpack_compact.p3d)
{{!}} <sqf>firstBackpack (getPos player nearestObject "weaponholder");</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[backpackContainer]]
{{!}} Unit([[Object]])
{{!}} [[Object]] (e.g 2bba9d00# 163957: backpack_compact.p3d)
{{!}} <sqf>backpackContainer player // currently same as [[unitBackpack]]</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[unitBackpack]]
{{!}} Unit([[Object]])
{{!}} [[Object]] (e.g 2bba9d00# 163957: backpack_compact.p3d)
{{!}} <sqf>unitBackpack player // currently same as [[backpackContainer]]</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[backpack]]
{{!}} Unit([[Object]])
{{!}} [[String]] (e.g 2bba9d00# 163957: backpack_compact.p3d)
{{!}} <sqf>backpack player // see also ([[typeOf]] [[backpackContainer]] [[player]]) or ([[typeOf]] [[unitBackpack]] [[player]])</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[backpackCargo]]
{{!}} [[Object]] (WeaponHolder, AmmoCrate, VehicleCrate)
{{!}} [[Array]] of [[String]] (e.g ["Backpack0", "Backpack1"])
{{!}} <sqf>backpackCargo _ammoCrate</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[getBackpackCargo]]
{{!}} [[Object]] (WeaponHolder, AmmoCrate, VehicleCrate)
{{!}} [[Array]] of [[Array]] (e.g [["Backpack0", "Backpack1"], [1, 1]])
{{!}} <sqf>getBackpackCargo _ammoCrate</sqf>

{{!}}-
{{!}} [[everyBackpack]]
{{!}} [[Object]] (WeaponHolder, AmmoCrate, VehicleCrate)
{{!}} [[Array]] of [[Object]] (e.g [22504f00# 163960: backpack_fast.p3d...])
{{!}} <sqf>everyBackpack _ammoCrate</sqf>

{{!}}}
}}
